Rebound Corridor.name: Rebound Corridor
Rebound Corridor.description: The user places a precise chain of balls across a damaged building, then rebounds through turns, vertical shafts and broken rooms to retrieve several stranded people one at a time. The user chooses each landing so a passenger never touches a sticky ball. The route lasts for the rest of the scene, but a missing or covered ball breaks that section, and the user's scalp needs rest afterward. Strain: severe.
